questions.q: Should towns ask teenagers for their opinions before making public plans? 英語60語程度で意見と理由二つを書きなさい。
questions.answer: I think they should. First, teenagers use parks, roads, and public transport, so their experiences can reveal problems adults may overlook. Second, taking part in discussions can help young people understand how decisions are made. Officials should explain which suggestions can be used and why, so asking for opinions becomes a meaningful part of planning rather than a formality.
